    Marketing · Full-time · Intermediate

Important to know:

The Pulsenmore ES is designed for single-fetus pregnancies. Scans can be performed starting from the 14th week of pregnancy. The device is regulatorily authorized for one user and one pregnancy. Patients are required to purchase it from authorized Pulsenmore representatives or distributors (qualified health organizations offering remote diagnostic interpretation services).
